captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a small, flat open-ended wrench with a solid circular head on one end and a U-shaped open wrench head on the other. The two heads are connected by a straight, uniform rectangular handle. The open-ended head is designed with a hexagonal cutout that is sliced open at the tip to allow side-entry onto a nut.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric open-ended wrench in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a solid circular head on one end and an open hexagonal wrench head on the other, connected by a rectangular handle. Make the nut diameter 'D', margin 'M', tool thickness 'H', and total length 'Ltot' easily adjustable parameters.
captions.factory: The wrench is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. The main body is a union of two cylinders at each end and a connecting cube for the handle. For the cutouts, a hexagon() module from the regular_shapes library is subtracted from both ends; additionally, a cube is subtracted from one end to open up the hexagon, creating the open-ended jaw of the wrench.
